headline: GREEN, but there's no plan: the block ended at the race on 7 Nov and needs repointing
summary: Readiness is GREEN. HRV is 72, up from 56 yesterday. RHR is 49 and sleep was 6.3h (score 78). Nothing is planned today or for the next 14 days, because the Valtellina block ended on race day (7 Nov) and the plan was never repointed. Fitness is slipping. CTL has fallen from 57.4 on race morning to 49.3. ATL is 32.4, so TSB is about +17. Last week (16-22 Nov) you logged 186 load over 4 sessions on 3 days, with nothing on 19, 20 or 22 Nov: treadmill 33 (17 Nov), run 61 (18 Nov), hike 27 and spin 65 (21 Nov). The 18 Nov run averaged 156bpm, which is the bottom of Z3 and not an easy day. That's your usual drift. With this readiness, today is a good day to start rebuilding. Suggested, though nothing is on the calendar: 60min Z2 run at 142-155bpm with 6x20s strides, or 60min Z2 spin at 134-147bpm if you're indoors. Keep the average HR under 155.
flags: No plan exists past 8 Nov. Next race, dates and target CTL are needed so a new block can be repointed in the coaching chat.
CTL 49.3 and falling about 1 point every 2 days. It's down 8.1 from race day, which is now more than recovery.
Drift: the 18 Nov run averaged 156bpm (Z3) and peaked at 184.
Sleep 4.8h on 18 Nov. Sleep is still the main limiter to watch.
